description:
Homepage product switcher (src/components/site/ProductSwitcher.astro driving regions in src/content/website/home.mdx and src/components/site/HeroV2.astro): a two-pill tablist that auto-rotates every 10s, locks on click, pauses on hover/focus, and keeps three per-track region pairs in visibility lockstep with the active pill. tests/smoke/smoke.spec.ts is fetch-only and can only assert the server-rendered default state, so the client-side contract is covered here. All URLs are origin-relative and resolve against `origin` in the Doc Detective config. No authentication, credentials, or test data are required.

Why the region checks read computed visibility and not just the `hidden` attribute: an inactive hero panel or hero aside keeps `hidden` but is styled `display: block; visibility: hidden` (HeroV2.astro `.pl-hero-v2-panel[hidden]`, site.css `.pl-hero-v2-aside[hidden]`) so switching tabs causes no layout shift. A text `find` inside such a region therefore still matches while the region is invisible to users, which would make prose assertions vacuous. The `runBrowserScript` probes below report attribute state and computed visibility together, so they fail if either drifts.

Auto-rotation is skipped entirely under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`. The rotate-dependent tests assume the default no-preference setting, which is what headless Chrome reports.

Timing note: rotation pauses while the pointer rests on the tablist or the hero panels and resumes with a fresh full 10s window on mouseleave, so the tests that must act on the docs track while it is still unlocked deliberately hover the tablist first and then move away. That buys a whole rotate window for the steps that follow instead of racing whatever remained of the current one.

Origin note: the config sets `origin` to https://promptless.ai, so this spec verifies the deployed site, not a branch preview. Run it after the change is deployed, or point `origin` at a preview URL for pre-merge verification.

tests.description: On load, the agent-instructions pill is the selected tab and all three agent-track regions are the visible ones. Also pins the documented 10s rotate window, which the script publishes as the --pl-switcher-rotate custom property so the CSS underline countdown cannot desync from the JS timer.

steps.description: Open the homepage
Wait for the product switcher pills to render
The switcher script ran and published the documented 10s auto-rotate window
Agent-instructions track is active: its hero panel, hero aside, and below-fold slot are shown and visible; all three customer-facing-docs regions are hidden and invisible

runBrowserScript.script: const state = (id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (!el) return id + '=missing'; const s = getComputedStyle(el); const visible = s.display !== 'none' && s.visibility !== 'hidden'; return id + '=' + (el.hasAttribute('hidden') ? 'hidden' : 'shown') + '/' + (visible ? 'visible' : 'invisible'); }; const tab = (id) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); return id + '=' + (el ? el.getAttribute('aria-selected') : 'missing'); }; return [tab('pl-product-switcher-tab-agents'), tab('pl-product-switcher-tab-docs'), state('pl-hero-panel-agents'), state('pl-hero-panel-docs'), state('pl-hero-aside-agents'), state('pl-hero-aside-docs'), state('pl-below-fold-agents'), state('pl-below-fold-docs')].join(' ');

tests.description: Regression guard for the reported bug. Auto-rotation alone -- no click, no lock -- must reveal every customer-facing-docs region, including #pl-below-fold-docs (the demo video and the social-proof, how-it-works, why-Promptless and Ask-AI sections) and #pl-hero-aside-docs (the testimonials). Before the fix, the docs below-fold slot additionally required an explicit click, so rotating onto the docs pill produced a docs preview with no below-fold docs content at all.

steps.description: Open the homepage

Wait for auto-rotation to select the customer-facing-docs pill on its own. Nothing is clicked, and the pointer stays off the tablist and the hero panels, which would pause rotation. Waiting on the selected state instead of sleeping a fixed 10s keeps the step from racing the rotate window.

Hover the now-active docs pill to pause rotation for the duration of the assertions below. Hovering pauses without locking, so the docs track stays active by rotation alone -- which is exactly the state under test.

All three customer-facing-docs regions followed the rotation and are visible; all three agent-track regions are hidden and invisible. This is the assertion that failed before the fix -- #pl-below-fold-docs stayed hidden while #pl-below-fold-agents was already hidden too.

steps.description: The rotate preview reaches real docs content, not an empty shell: the demo video facade and the social-proof heading inside #pl-below-fold-docs are both on screen

runBrowserScript.script: const slot = document.getElementById('pl-below-fold-docs'); if (!slot) return 'slot=missing'; const onScreen = (el) => { if (!el) return 'absent'; const s = getComputedStyle(el); if (s.display === 'none' || s.visibility === 'hidden') return 'invisible'; return el.getClientRects().length > 0 ? 'onscreen' : 'norects'; }; const heading = Array.from(slot.querySelectorAll('h2')).find((h) => /See why Vitess and Helm chose Promptless/.test(h.textContent || '')); return ['video=' + onScreen(slot.querySelector('.lite-youtube[data-video-id="AONpRsZJkTY"]')), 'socialProofHeading=' + onScreen(heading)].join(' ');

Clicking also moves focus to the clicked pill and makes it the only tabbable one (roving tabindex).

tests.description: Guard added alongside the fix. Because the docs below-fold slot is now revealed during a rotate preview, starting the demo video counts as committing to the docs track: it stops auto-rotation so the next rotate cannot tear the embed down mid-playback. Clicking the LiteYouTube facade injects an iframe from youtube-nocookie.com, so this test needs outbound network access to that host; the assertion is about rotation stopping and the embed surviving, not about playback itself.

steps.description: Open the homepage
Wait for auto-rotation to select the customer-facing-docs pill on its own, which reveals the below-fold demo video

Hover the active docs pill to pause auto-rotation, so the steps that follow are not racing whatever is left of the current rotate window. Moving off the tablist to the video restarts a fresh full window.
Scroll the demo video facade into view
Play the demo video, which activates the LiteYouTube embed and pins the docs track
The click activated the embed rather than being swallowed by the facade
Wait longer than one 10s rotate window to prove playing the video stopped auto-rotation
The docs track is still active, the below-fold slot holding the video is still on screen, and the injected iframe was never torn back down to the facade

tests.description: Hovering the tablist pauses auto-rotation without locking it, so the active track does not change while the pointer rests there. Covered because the demo-video test above relies on this pause to stay deterministic, and because a broken pause would make the rotate-preview fix jump under the user's cursor.
